SELECT
  g.installments AS payment_installments,
  COALESCE(p.order_count, 0) AS order_count
FROM
  (SELECT generate_series(1,5) AS installments) g
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT
    op.payment_installments,
    COUNT(DISTINCT op.order_id) AS order_count
  FROM
    order_payments op
  JOIN
    orders o ON op.order_id = o.order_id
  WHERE
    op.payment_installments BETWEEN 1 AND 5
  GROUP BY
    op.payment_installments
) p
  ON p.payment_installments = g.installments
ORDER BY
  g.installments;
